entities.summary: Rosi Golan is an Israeli singer-songwriter. Since 2008 she has released two LPs and two EPs. Her songs have been featured in feature films such as Dear John and Tiger Eyes, TV shows such as Vampire Diaries, Grey's Anatomy, Private Practice, Brothers & Sisters, One Tree Hill, Ghost Whisperer, and numerous commercials.
